reviews.t: Tiny, smell terrible, and have... corn inside of them?
reviews.x: The first thing I noticed when I opened the box was how small they were. Not to worry though, they're "flattened and dried" before shipping, according to a card in the box. Soak in warm water for a couple minutes and it should be fine.  So I fill the sink up with warm water, take one of the sponges out of the box and two things become apparent: 1) It smells horrible. Think decaying vegetables. 2) It's as hard as a rock. Not spongy, or compliant, like any other loofah I've used before. Thick, and

If you’re into the natural loofah game, I’m sure these are excellent. However if you’re just exploring new territories of soap applicators for the shower, maybe not so much. Sure soak it, it will still be the toughest thing you have scraped across your body. It smells very natural, just like a barn or the elephants at the zoo. So natural, the loofah seeds it still contains will get lodged in your body crevices. I’m not joking. Like I said if you’re one of those hardcore all natural people - I’m

I was nervous to buy natural loofahs because I have read in the reviews that they are rough on the skin. However, the instructions say to soak them before each wash and by doing this, they are the same texture as a wash cloth (in my opinion). I chose these over other loofahs because they aren’t bleached. I am happy with the size too, they aren’t overwhelmingly large. Once I run out of this pack I’ll probably come back to this seller.

18 May 2020  I purchased these to try a more organic and natural way to clean my body and my dishes. I have been using plastic loofah for over a decade. I never thought to look into natural ones, until I started to see how much bacteria is in a sponge and a typical loofah. I placed mine in the sink with warm water to allow it to expand and to also clean it. After my first use I cut it in half for use in the shower. And cut the other one into one one inch sections to be used as a dish cleaning sp

reviews.t: Really helps to make skin SOFT!
reviews.x: Everything about the ordering and receiving the Natural Loofahs was easy. The actual product is one that I have been using for a year or so. I like the feel of my skin after using the Loofah, especially when my Grandson took my arm and said " What soft skin you have Grandmama" .  He is 15 and does not just hand out complaints to his elders. Sweet!
I love the fact that it's eco-friendly and made from a plant! It's also great for exfoliating your skin and getting all the dirt off. Make sure you soak in hot water before use!

There are a lot of mixed reviews on this product so I was not sure what to expect. I agree with some of the negative reviews that when the product arrived it was flat, more rough, had a slight odor and there were the little black pieces of loofah inside the holes. However, after about two weeks of using the product really softened up and the other “complaints” were resolved. It’s great in the shower to exfoliate but is not too rough on my sensitive skin.

Awful. I have bought natural organic luffas over the years so I know what they are like. These smell so terribly. And in one of them there was black mold and growth. Disgusting. I will not be purchasing again. I'm going to boil them to see if the smell will disappear. I know Amazon will refund but I just don't want to deal with repackaging and returning so hopefully I can disinfect them myself and use. I have decided anyway in light of what is going on to buy directly from businesses anyway.

This is my second time repurchasing these loofa sponges. My first order was perfect and for every description they gave. The loofa on the left is from the first order, and the loofa on the right is from the second order. They claim to be “non bleached” but this order i got were definitely bleached. They didn’t even come with the natural loofa seeds in it. They were also very flimsy unlike the first order i got.

So dense it's like rubbing a stick against your skin. There isn't much sponginess so the soap doesn't even lather well with it. Not worth the money. - I previously got larger Egyptian ones and didn't think there would be much quality difference between them but I was wrong. I would NOT recommend these.

These sponges remind me of this one episode of Ren & Stimpy when the man grabs Ren and drags him across his beard stubble and is ripping his skin off. Personally, I don’t mind the roughness of the sponges. They buff my skin and leave it smooth and clean. Watch that episode though…

These things REEK to high heaven! No matter how many times I wash them, the stench stays. I have grown & used loofahs all my life & I've never smelled anything so disgusting...it's so bad it makes me want to puke each time I try to use it. Returning these for sure. ICK.

reviews.t: Actually bought for my buns to chew!
reviews.x: I was hesitant to leave a review because I bought these for my rabbits to chew! Well..they are in heaven. They are all natural no dyes and not bleached so if it’s safe for my rabbits then it’s definitely safe for human skin! Fast shipping, great quality.

I've gotten a few of these from other vendors and these were stained with something funky and smelled of mothballs terribly. I threw them away, basically unusable even after a diluted bleach bath. I won't be buying from them again.

Used these for homemade loofah honey soap rounds and they were absolutely perfect !! We soaked them which made them an ease to cut. We were able to cut 5 perfect pieces each log of loofah and were truly amazed at the quality

reviews.t: Good for exfoliating In the shower
reviews.x: These seem to work as they should to exfoliate. However, they don’t look like the picture. They arrived completely flattened and don’t change shape when wet!

Having used loofahs in the 80s and remembering how naturally refreshing they were, I was at first disappointed to see they (3-pack) were so small. Then, they had been squished flat in order to jam them into a very small cardboard container. The Chinese-English brochure was hilarious as usual but in their "FAQ" section it mentioned a smell. reviews.t: Just what a natural loofah is supposed to be!
reviews.x: I’ve been using natural fiber loofahs (not the plastic kind) off and on since 2010. By nature there is some variation, depending on the size of the underlying plant, the way it’s made/grown, any bleaching, softening or other treatments applied that may change the texture. This is GREAT value for three medium-to-small sized natural loofahs.  The first time you use it you gotta soak it in warm water to puff up (it will turn into an oval cylinder, rather than staying like a flat pad) and release it

reviews.t: May not be best for sensitive skin.
reviews.x: Good value if you are looking for an all-natural, cylinder-shaped, exfoliating loofah for bath or shower time.  These came in a 3-pack that should last at least 3 months if I discard of the loofahs as recommended by the seller (every 4 weeks or so). The loofahs came dried out, but a few minutes in warm water brought it back to life. I took note of how abrasive the loofah is on my skin immediately, and understandably so - the purpose here is to exfoliate your skin! Though the loofah is slightly m

reviews.t: not soft - not sure it''s really exfoliating
reviews.x: It is many years since I had a real loofah product and I wanted to go back to the natural thing.  Even when wet it stays hard and rough and I don't feel soothing exfoliation.  It is probably helping some.  The price is certainly GOOD!  I'm only using the first one.  I'll take another when I travel this winter ...  and if either ever gets moldy or unappealing, then I know I have a third.  I will keep using it, them.  In the past, my recollection was that they softened when wet.  This one is only

reviews.t: Made me feel more dirty than clean
reviews.x: While I did want to like this product, I simply couldn't stand the irritation and pain this thing caused to my sensitive eczema riddled skin. While the first 2 weeks of breaking this thing were hell, the loofah is still abrasive and goes through body wash like crazy. If you are filled with self loathing and have an additional 5-10 minutes in your morning allocate to your showers then by all means buy this product. Just don't be surprised when you realize that your body wash is all gone.

reviews.t: Scratchy and rougher than i thought
reviews.x: I bought these thinking i would replace that old plastic loofa, but these are way to rough for my skin.  I let them soak as instructed (even longer), but they still didnt get quite as soft as i would have liked.  Great for scrubbing elbows and knees but definitely not for everyday use.  I even tried trimming them into a washcloth shape hoping that would allow them to be a little more forgiving, but NOPE.  Wont be buying these again.

I wanted to try a natural loofah, but these are not for me. They are very hard and scratchy, even after soaking, and as other reviewers noted they have a bad smell. I soaked them overnight in a vinegar water solution, and though that helped diminish the smell it is still there. These loofahs are not pliable at all -- it's like using a board with sandpaper. I wanted to get away from plastic, but the cheaper synthetic ones work well.

Natural loofahs are yellowish in color, firm the first couple times of use, and often have seed debris still left inside. What I got were none of these things. I got clean, soft, obviously bleached, white loofahs. The Q&A pamphlet that comes with the loofahs even state as much. My old loofah, that I got from the same company, retains all of the former qualities despite how it looks. Truly disappointing and will look elsewhere. 😕

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the loofahs as effective exfoliators that leave skin soft and clean.
Several reviewers complain that the loofahs smell terrible, with some reporting mold or stains.
Some reviewers note the loofahs arrive flat, small, and rough, though soaking them softens them for use.
Reviewers appreciate that the loofahs are natural, non-bleached, and eco-friendly.
A few reviewers report quality inconsistencies, including bleached or overly dense loofahs.
